To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the moisture tension and doses phosphate fertilization affect the plant growth and development of A-7572 sweet corn (Z. mays L.) in a Calcium Vertisols; and 2) the moisture tension of the soil affects the yield of A-7571 hybrid sweet corn (Z.mays L.), and the doses of phosphate fertilizers do not affect the yield of A7572 hybrid sweet corn ( Z.mays L.).
the effects of soil moisture tension and doses on phosphate fertilization on the yield of the sweet corn hybrid A-7573 were significant.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effects of water stress and fertilization on yield of a sweet corn hybrid.
the evaluation of the effects of moisture tension and phosphate doses on the yield of sweet corn A7573 hybrid.
the effects of moisture tension and phosphate doses in the yield components of sweet maize hybrid A-7573.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the effect of soil moisture tension and phosphate fertilizer doses on the development of sweet corn hybrid A-7573, was statistically significant.
the moisture tension and the phosphate fertilization had a negative effect on the growth, development and yield of A-7572 sweet corn (Z. mays) hybrid.
the sweet corn A- 7573 (Z. mays L.) showed the highest values of yield components in the treatments of -5, -30 and -55kPa.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
moisture tension of -5 and -30 kPa, and phosphate fertilization of 80 kg/ha, were the most suitable for the A-7573 hybrid.
the moisture tension and phosphate fertilizer application had a positive effect on the development and yield components of the sweet corn hybrid A-7573.
soil moisture tension is the limiting factor of the yield components of the sweet corn A- 7573 hybrid.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, in the conditions of the study, the best yield was obtained with a moisture tension of -30kPa, and a dose of 80kgha- 1 of phosphorus fertilization, with a yield of 12.6 tons per hectare.
soil moisture tension and the doses of phosphate fertilizers are factors that influence the development and production of sweet corn.
the moisture tension and the phosphate fertilization have an effect on plant growth and development, as well as on yield components.
